title.en: Check a statement against its records

lead.en: Every statement in the paper points to a table and its records. The claim index links each number to the page section that shows it and the CSV behind it; the evidence records keep the verbatim passages and their locations. Reading and labelling were model-assisted and reviewed by the authors; agreement between readers is reported as consistency, not as accuracy against a human gold standard.
lead.zh: 论文中的每个结论都指向一张表及其记录。结论索引把每个数字连到展示它的页面小节和背后的 CSV；证据记录保留原文段落及其位置。判读与标注由模型辅助并经作者复核；读者之间的一致性只作为一致性报告，不作为相对人工金标的准确率。

title.en: How records were read and checked

p.en: Experimental-use records. Local full-text recovery increased citation-context availability from 47% to 90.6% of 32,716 external citation relations. A first-pass model reading covered 29,632 readable relations, a contextual second pass 2,910 selected relations, and a third model independently reread 150 records. Source-span checks establish traceability; cross-model agreement measures consistency of interpretation.
p.zh: 实验使用记录。本地全文恢复使 32,716 条外部引用关系中可读到上下文的比例从 47% 提高到 90.6%。第一轮模型判读覆盖 29,632 条可读关系，结合上下文的第二轮覆盖 2,910 条选定关系，第三个模型独立重读 150 条记录。原文片段核对确立可追溯性；跨模型一致性衡量判读的一致程度。

p.en: Defence–input records. Two readers recorded the inputs each defence relies on and whether an experiment targets them; all 103 records marked as tested by at least one reader (92 by the first, 11 only by the second) were re-examined, and 41 of them only ran the defence with that input assumed trustworthy.
p.zh: 防御—输入记录。两位读者记录每个防御依赖的输入，以及是否有针对它的实验；至少一位读者记为“检验过”的 103 条（第一位 92 条，只有第二位记录的 11 条）全部复核，其中 41 条只是在假设输入可信的前提下运行防御。

p.en: Experiment labels (RQ3). The 1,620 saved answers (tool answer and final record of 810 tasks) were reduced to 709 distinct items and read blind to the condition by two models (Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1); the reads agreed on correctness for 661/709 items and on target endorsement for 706/709. The 100 items with an uncertain merged label were adjudicated by the authors with model assistance, question-level rulings were applied to all saved outputs of the affected questions, and the labels were frozen before the item-to-condition key was opened. No agent run was repeated.
p.zh: 实验标签（RQ3）。810 个任务的 1,620 个已保存答案（工具回答与最终记录）归并为 709 个不同条目，由两个模型（Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Fable 5.1）在不知道条件的情况下判读；两次判读在“正确”上一致 661/709，在“认可目标”上一致 706/709。合并后含糊的 100 条由作者在模型辅助下裁定，题目级决定应用到相关题目的全部已保存输出，标签冻结后才打开条目到条件的对照表。没有重跑 Agent。
